name: fleet-core
description: Portable Fleet Core slice carrying three modules and one data registry: the shared 429 rate-limit retry and backoff primitive with its circuit breaker, the IntentEnvelope run-start posture schema ported under the resolve-fleet-commons-sibling deterministic transform, and the tier palette with the models.json model/effort registry it reads. This is a single vertical slice of the upstream Fleet Core library, not the whole library.
